title: CVE-2026-124194: the Outlook zero-day that steals the NTLMv2 hash by opening an Office file
content_md:
CVE-2026-124194: the Outlook zero-day that steals the NTLMv2 hash by opening an Office file. A bug in Outlook allows bypassing the external-content warning when a crafted Office file is opened, leaking the user's NTLMv2 hash.

via Mastodon https://spcnet.it/cve-2026-124194-lo-zero-day-di-outlook-che-ruba-lhash-ntlmv2-aprendo-un-file-office/

CVE-2026-124194.evidence: Described as a zero-day that steals the NTLMv2 hash when an Office file is opened.
